spine.deviation_notes: A 0.1-launch player would 'miss' the specific pre-nerf degeneracy (always-Ignite at 45% base speed on a trivially-timed window) -- but that is a TUNING artifact, not a mappable mechanism; the engine has no 'trivially-timed window' anti-pattern to reproduce. The channel-charge-release fire-wave mechanism maps cleanly (CLOSE); the deviation is that the trap was balance, not a missing feature.

skills.delivery_notes: channeled melee heavy-strike: channel to charge the weapon with Fire, then RELEASE with Perfect Timing (a skill-native timing indicator) to create a damaging wave of intense Fire in a forward melee arc. commit=wind-up, amp=spiky. In 0.1 (mapped era) it ALWAYS applied Ignite on hit and had 45% base attack speed -- the always-Ignite + fast base was the degenerate charge loop nerfed to 35% + conditional-Ignite in 0.2. burn ailment (always-Ignite, 0.1). Physical->fire conversion is the point. Forward arc + charged wave -> melee_arc (not ground_slam; fetched text is a forward WAVE, no downward quake).

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: negative=1 TRAP KIT mapped HONESTLY. PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_uptime routes the always-Ignite DoT-uptime that WAS the trap (0.1 always-Ignite + fast base = permanent burn on a trivial loop); ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL routes the phys->fire slam. verify_ledger: era-0.1 UNSUPPORTED but negative_canon CONFIRMED (launch loop trivially degenerate; reworked by 0.2).
